pageSubtitle: Metrics 8–10 — Dormant Rate, Lost Customer Value, and Reactivation Rate
m8TooltipInfo:
"Dormant" means a customer whose last transaction has passed the inactive-month threshold. The threshold varies by division business category (B2B Distributor, B2B Project, B2C, Manufacturing), configured in Settings → Threshold.

Formula: Dormant Rate = (Dormant Existing Customers ÷ Total Existing Customers) × 100%.
Existing Customer = had transaction history before this period (this population already includes dormant ones, not just those still actively buying).
m8TooltipClickHint: Click to view dormant customer list
dormantCountInfo: Customers who haven't bought in a while, past the inactivity threshold for their business category.
m8TopCustomersInfo: Sorted by highest estimated loss (average monthly revenue over the last 12 months before going dormant × months dormant)
m9TooltipInfo:
Measures the total business value held up or at risk of being lost from dormant customers — used to assess how much revenue has not been retained or reactivated.

Sorted by highest lost value.

Formula: Estimated Lost Value = Average Monthly Revenue (last 12 months before going dormant) × Months Dormant.
Dormant Customer = a customer with transaction history who did not transact within the dormant threshold period.
m9TooltipClickHint: Click to view the customer's revenue history
m9TotalLossInfo: Estimated revenue lost because these customers stopped buying.
m9TotalLossGpInfo: Estimated gross profit lost because these customers stopped buying.
m10TooltipInfo:
Measures the effectiveness of the reactivation strategy and how well the company recovers customers who had stopped transacting.

"Reactivated" means a customer who was previously dormant and made at least 1 transaction again — counted from transactions that have actually happened up to today within the current period, no need to wait for the period to close.

Formula: Reactivation Rate = (Dormant Customers Who Transacted Again ÷ Total Dormant Customers at the Start of This Period) × 100%.
m10TooltipClickHint: Click to view the list of reactivated customers
m10SummaryAllInfo: All customers who have transacted before this period.
m10SummaryActiveInfo: Customers who haven't crossed the inactivity threshold yet, including those who just became active again after being dormant.
m10SummaryDormantInfo: Customers who haven't bought in a while and haven't come back yet.
m10SummaryReactivatedInfo: Customers who had stopped buying, then purchased again this period.
m10SummaryRelapsedInfo: Customers who came back for a while, but have stopped buying again.
m10ReactivationEmpty: No reactivated customers in this period
m10TopCustomersInfo: Sorted by most recent reactivation date; ties broken by highest average monthly revenue
